title: 新兴市场跑赢发达市场：涨幅却只靠少数AI资产，非AI经济体怎么办
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: Emerging markets have had a roller coaster ride.
segments.zh: 新兴市场经历了过山车般的行情。

segments.en: For most of this year they've beaten key benchmarks in the developed world and have taken in billions of dollars in investment.
segments.zh: 今年大部分时间里，它们跑赢了发达市场的关键基准，并吸引了数十亿美元的资金流入。

segments.en: Look a little closer though and a different story emerges.
segments.zh: 但仔细一看，情况却有所不同。

segments.en: A big portion of those gains were driven by a small number of assets and most of them linked to the AI boom,
segments.zh: 这些涨幅很大一部分由少数资产驱动，且多与人工智能热潮相关，

segments.en: like Taiwan's chip makers and South Korea's memory giants.
segments.zh: 比如台湾的芯片制造商和韩国的存储巨头。

segments.en: So where does that leave countries without a global AI play?
segments.zh: 那么，没有全球人工智能布局的国家又将如何？

segments.en: India for example is a giant pricing consumer market for everything from healthcare to luxury goods but could it end up being left far behind
segments.zh: 以印度为例，它是一个巨大的消费市场，涵盖从医疗保健到奢侈品的各个领域，但如果市场参与者继续痴迷于人工智能，它是否会被远远甩在后面？

segments.en: if investors continue to obsess over AI?
segments.zh: 如果市场参与者继续痴迷于人工智能？

segments.en: I sat down with two veteran investors on the sidelines of Bloomberg's new economy forum in New Delhi. Mark Mason has overseen emerging market strategies worldwide.
segments.zh: 我在彭博新经济论坛新德里会场间隙与两位资深市场参与者进行了交谈。马克·梅森负责全球新兴市场策略。

segments.en: First as CEO of Canada's biggest pension fund and now advising Singapore's sovereign wealth fund GIC. He is also the founder of the AI-focused
segments.zh: 他先是担任加拿大最大养老基金的首席执行官，现在为新加坡主权财富基金GIC提供咨询。他还是专注于人工智能的

segments.zh: 我们在全球范围内普遍发现，我们高估了发达市场的稳定性，而低估了新兴市场的稳定性以及你所称的新兴
